integrity: The minimality and chamber statements are proved analytically from exact Jefferson quotient inequalities. A standard-library exact-rational verifier independently replays highest-averages allocations, divisor intervals, finite integer grids, witness minimality, and the probability integrals.
scientific_limitations: Pure apportionment only: positive shares, no minimum-seat constraints, and unique Jefferson quotient cutoff. The probabilities are normalized Lebesgue measures on the share simplices, not empirical frequencies.
title: Sharp first upper-quota failures of Jefferson apportionment
